title: Best Study-Time-of-Day for Recall
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vocab:review
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats avg(recall_pct) as recall, count as reviews by hour
| where reviews>=20
| sort - recall
description: Compares your recall accuracy by the hour you study, revealing when your brain retains vocabulary best.
value: Studying when your recall is naturally highest makes every review more efficient, a small but real edge.
implementation: Ingest reviews with timestamps into `index=personal`; compare recall by hour.
visualization: Bar chart of recall accuracy by study hour.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what time of day you remember words best, so you can study when it works.
